2608.24310.title: OPDSearch+: On-Policy Distillation with RL Refinement for Search-Augmented Reasoning
2608.24310.paper_summary: Search-augmented reasoning remains difficult for small language models. On-policy distillation (OPD) from trained teachers offers a promising direction, but suffers from two issues: (1) high-quality multi-turn search trajectories depend on dynamic retriever responses, making SFT data prohibitively expensive to collect at scale; (2) task-specifically trained teachers incur substantial training cost, while directly applying OPD with an off-the-shelf teacher without task-specific fine-tuning constrains the student to the teacher's performance ceiling and suffers from severe training instability. We propose OPDSearch+, the first distillation paradigm that requires no teacher fine-tuning for search-augmented reasoning. We investigate the role of a frozen off-the-shelf instruct model as the teacher in on-policy distillation, and reveal a key insight: the teacher reshapes the student's policy distribution so that subsequent RL converges to a superior solution that RL alone cannot reach. In stage one, the student interacts with a live search engine and is distilled via a per-position forward KL objective, transferring reasoning decomposition and evidence integration skills without any task-specific teacher training. In stage two, RL refines the distilled student from a richer behavioral foundation, achieving performance that RL alone cannot reach from scratch. Across seven QA benchmarks, OPDSearch+ with a 3B model consistently outperforms all prior 3B RL baselines, achieving gains of 13.1% on HotpotQA and 8.5% on 2WikiMultihopQA.
2608.24310.paper_summary_zh: 搜尋增強推理對於小型語言模型來說仍然很困難。從訓練好的教師進行的在線蒸餾（OPD）提供了一個有前景的方向，但面臨兩個問題：（1）高質量的多回合搜尋軌跡依賴於動態檢索器的反應，使得大規模收集SFT數據的成本過高；（2）針對特定任務訓練的教師會產生可觀的訓練成本，而直接應用沒有針對特定任務微調的現成教師的OPD會限制學生的表現上限，並遭受嚴重的訓練不穩定性。我們提出了OPDSearch+，這是第一個不需要教師微調的搜尋增強推理蒸餾範式。我們研究了作為教師的凍結現成指導模型在在線蒸餾中的角色，並揭示了一個關鍵見解：教師重塑學生的策略分佈，使得隨後的強化學習收斂到一個RL單獨無法達到的更優解。在第一階段，學生與一個實時搜尋引擎互動，並通過每個位置的前向KL目標進行蒸餾，轉移推理分解和證據整合技能，而無需任何針對特定任務的教師訓練。在第二階段，強化學習從更豐富的行為基礎中精煉蒸餾後的學生，實現了RL單獨無法從零開始達到的表現。在七個QA基準上，使用3B模型的OPDSearch+始終超越所有先前的3B RL基準，在HotpotQA上獲得了13.1%的增益，在2WikiMultihopQA上獲得了8.5%的增益。
